name: Lancer
summary: A heavy cavalryman whose lance, driven home at a full run, throws enemies to the ground.
description: Lancers train for years to hold a spear steady against a horse's gait, and they take it badly when a battle is fought in a forest. In a good field, a line of them is the hammer that breaks the other army.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the lancer moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Lance attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {dmg:2d6:piercing} damage and must succeed on a {dc:str} Strength saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lancer makes two attacks, using Lance or Longsword in any combination.

actions.name: Lance
actions.attackNote: with Disadvantage if the target is within 5 feet of the lancer
